text:
Diego: Cutting RC for a parity fix in the batching path. RC id: catalyst-6311. Pinning image and opening a 20m quiet window. Need QE + RM ack.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: catalyst-6311 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:deadbeef | pinned=true | start canary: `/deploy promote catalyst-6311 --to=canary --traffic=5%`

Mira: Acked. Kicking off smoke + regression subset (fast). ETA ~7m.

Sam: Infra precheck: GPUs allocated, PV mounts ok, KV prefetch scheduled +30s after canary start.

Mira: Smoke: PASS (30 requests). No errors, p50 slightly improved. sample: `200 OK` from all canary pods.

Diego: Canary plan: 5% initial. If stable 10m, ramp to 30% over 15m. Abort triggers: sustained 3m error rate >0.7% OR p95 jump >150ms. Paste rollback snippet for release notes.

Sam: Rollback/playbook snippet:
```bash
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback promo-6311001 --to=stable
# unpin image
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:deadbeef
# clear kv prefetch flag if necessary
/k8s patch daemonset batching -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kv-prefetch":"false"}}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: Action queued: `/deploy start catalyst-6311 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=true`

SRE-Bot: Quiet window engaged for 20m. Non-critical alerts suppressed, critical will still page.

Diego: RM conditional signoff needed: RM-Alex, will approve staged promotion if 30% is stable for 20m with no regressions in sampled outputs.

RM-Alex: Conditional signoff granted pending 20m stability at 30%. Please include rollback snippet in release notes and mark the RC ready for full lift in next maintenance window if green.

Mira: Kicking ramp to 30% now: `/deploy promote catalyst-6311 --to=prod --staged "30%:15m" --note "batching parity fix"`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Promo ID: promo-6311001. Check status: `/deploy status promo-6311001`. Expected ramp finish ~6311123400.

Mira: 35m update: 30% stable for 20m, telemetry healthy, no quality regressions on sample checks.

RM-Alex: Final signoff — RM approves staged promo complete. Schedule full lift in next change window and publish release notes including ops playbook.

Diego: Thanks everyone — publishing release notes: "Batching parity fix; p50 improved; KV prefetch enabled for warm paths." Closing thread.
